changes: All named characters, including welcome cast, use complete reviewed native pose frames rather than independently positioned faces and limbs.
Customizable bust avatars use generated continuous shoulder-elbow-wrist-hand silhouettes and one registered body coordinate system.
Blinks retain native head and facial registration. Neck crops remain behind collars.
Satchel attaches at the shoulder/chest without crossing the waving forearm. Soft-waves hair viewport includes its previously clipped left edge at unchanged native scale.
Rejected three-hand student source frame is excluded from playback.
Obsolete public part-rig prototypes are retired, and visual anatomy is a mandatory release gate.
Versioned entries and a new service-worker cache prevent returning visitors retaining the old animation modules.
limits: Automated measurements cannot determine whether a drawing is anatomically sound. The separate per-frame visual verdict is a required gate.
The matrix covers all six skin tones and every free hair/outfit/accessory option through seven configurations; it does not claim visual review of every possible combined avatar.
Chromium/Edge at four viewport widths; other browser engines are not claimed tested.
scopePreserved: Original Horizons wordmark and supplied font
